description: This file contains utility functions related to MCP server URLs, including extracting tokens, masking URLs, and validating server URLs and names. It is specific to MCP URL handling within the project.

methods.name: extractMCPToken
methods.description: Extracts a token and base URL from an MCP URL string.

methods.name: maskUrl
methods.description: Returns a masked version of the URL, replacing the token with ellipses.

methods.name: getMaskedAndFullUrl
methods.description: Provides both masked URL and token presence status.

methods.name: validateMCPServerUrl
methods.description: Validates whether a given URL string matches expected URL formats.
